panels.title: Active matches
panels.description: Live rooms on this process. Drops to zero between matches, so read it together with the creation rate.

panels.title: Match creation rate
panels.description: rate() rather than the raw counter: counters are per process and reset on restart.

panels.title: Match completion rate
panels.description: Matches that reached the terminal over state. A persistent gap against the creation rate means rooms are leaking.

panels.title: Intent rate
panels.description: Word submission intents received by the server, before validation.

panels.title: Intent outcome
panels.description: Accepted versus rejected words. A rising rejection rate usually means client/server dictionary drift, not cheating.

panels.title: Telemetry enqueue rate
panels.description: Events accepted into the asynchronous exporter buffer.

panels.title: Telemetry write rate
panels.description: Events actually written by the exporter. Should track the enqueue rate.

panels.title: Telemetry backpressure
panels.description: The panel to alert on. Telemetry is deliberately non-blocking: a saturated buffer drops events instead of slowing a match, so observability is lost while gameplay looks healthy.

panels.title: Matches created (process total)
panels.description: Raw counter. Resets when the service restarts — use the rate panel for trending.
